global_dependencies: GPIO has no dedicated DPORT clock-gate bit in DPORT_PERIP_CLK_EN_REG (0x3FF000C0) - it is always clocked; confirmed by absence of any GPIO entry in that register's field list.
For any pad to be usable as a GPIO, its IO_MUX_<pin>_REG (e.g. IO_MUX_GPIO5_REG) MCU_SEL field must select the GPIO function (see Section 6.4 Direct I/O via IO MUX).
GPIO_ENABLE_REG / GPIO_ENABLE1_REG must be configured to mark a pin as output before GPIO_OUT_REG/GPIO_OUT1_REG writes have any effect.
GPIO_PINn_REG.GPIO_PINn_INT_TYPE and GPIO_PINn_INT_ENA must be configured before GPIO_STATUS_REG/GPIO_ACPU_INT_REG/GPIO_PCPU_INT_REG interrupt status bits become meaningful.

RTC_IO_MUX (RTCIO_*) registers apply only to the RTC-capable pins (GPIO0, 2, 4, 12-15, 25-27, 32-39); using a pin in RTC/analog mode requires RTCIO_RTC_GPIO_PINn_REG configuration instead of/in addition to the digital GPIO_PINn_REG.
